Title: Mix flour & water
Description:
Combine 500 g bread flour with 350 g water.
Mix until no dry bits remain.

Title: Rest (autolyse)
Description: Cover the bowl and leave at room temperature.

Title: Add starter
Description: Add 100 g active starter and 10 g salt. Squeeze to combine.

Title: Bulk ferment
Description: Stretch and fold every 30 minutes, 4 times, then leave covered.

Title: Shape
Description: Turn out, pre-shape, rest briefly, then shape and place in a floured basket.
